title: CatMSG
description: A lightweight and customizable private messaging system
body:
## Description
**CatMSG** is a plugin designed to implement an optimized private messaging system, with blocking features, fast responses, and data persistence. Ideal for servers that want a more complete, configurable, and optimized private messaging system without affecting performance.
## Commands
- /msg <player> <message>
- /reply <message>
- /msgtoggle
- /block <player>
- /catm reload
## What does it offer?
- Private messaging system
- Fast response system
- Player blocking system
- Data persistence
- PlaceholderAPI support
- Optimized performance / low resource usage
## How configurable is it?
The plugin is **99.99% configurable**, allowing you to customize the automatic prefix, message formats for sending and receiving, and error messages. It also includes full PlaceholderAPI support and is designed to have minimal impact on server performance.

## Information
- > Minecraft version: **+1.19.4**
- > Software: **Paper, Purpur, Spigot, Bukkit**
- > Plugin version: **v1.0**
- > More updates in: [our Discord server](https://discord.gg/56QjQmsVc5)
